blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Pinget National High School in Baguio City is investigating fresh allegations of bullying and assault involving its pupils that were recorded on video outside school premises, according to an official school statement issued Oct. 7. The alleged incident occurred on Sept. 18 in a subdivision in Barangay Pico in La Trinidad, and involved seven adolescents aged 13 to 14, according to the La Trinidad Municipal Police Station. Police did not provide details about the alleged offenses.
